547802.why: The Temple of Dendur sits beside a pool under a wall of glass. Sit on the ledge and let the room go quiet.

544227.why: William the hippo is small, blue and covered in lotus flowers. Nobody leaves him without smiling.

544442.why: Hatshepsut as a sphinx: a queen who ruled as king, carved in granite and completely sure of herself.

543937.why: You can walk into Perneb's tomb. Four thousand years old, cool, dim and very still.

544214.why: A little wooden boat with a whole crew rowing in time. Meketre packed it for the afterlife so he would never travel alone.

545281.why: A model granary with tiny scribes counting the grain. Ordinary work, done carefully, made to last forever.

543867.why: A board game from 1800 BCE with ivory hounds and jackals for pieces. Somebody played this with a friend.

544186.why: Senwosret III has the most tired, thoughtful face in the whole museum. A king who had seen a lot.

544692.why: Haremhab, before he was pharaoh, sitting cross-legged with a scroll and his head down, working.

547951.why: Eutyches was a boy in Roman Egypt. His portrait looks straight at you across two thousand years.

544320.why: Mentuwoser sits at a table piled with food while his family brings more. A picture of being looked after.

544068.why: An ivory gazelle, alert and about to move, standing on a little hill of desert flowers.

544326.why: Khnumnakht's coffin is painted with eyes so he could look out, and a door so he could leave. Grief, made practical.

548344.why: Nauny's Book of the Dead shows her heart being weighed against a feather. A long scroll about facing yourself.

544118.why: A bronze cat sitting perfectly upright with gold earrings. Composed, a little aloof, and not going anywhere.
